name: CaLLMara
detailed_description:
RETURN TO THE SILENCE WHERE DARKNESS ECHOES

CallMara is an atmospheric first-person narrative game set in a dark medieval world plagued by ancient evil. You play as a nameless protagonist who wakes up in a deep forest and discovers that his native village has disappeared, leaving only silence, rustles in the branches and traces of something sinister.

Trying to understand what happened, you explore abandoned houses, a rotten church, flooded cellars and a forgotten field of sunflowers, where, according to rumors, pagans offered their prayers to the ancient gods. Finds lead you on a trail of madness: notes, bloody amulets, strange symbols and whispering voices. Gradually you uncover the terrible truth - it was you, possessed by anger and pain, who once awakened the thing that destroyed everyone.

Now - you are the last witness and the last victim.

GAME FEATURES:

  • First-person narrative psychological horror

Explore a world where reality blurs on the border between reason and madness. Find clues, study texts and immerse yourself in the dark history of a village possessed by an ancient cult.

  • An atmosphere of tension and fear

The dynamic change of day and night, the oppressive weather, the ominous whispers in the forest and the shadows that move in the distance all create a sense of constant danger and loneliness.

  • Exploring and finding items

Move freely through the open world: from forests to altars. Open doors, light torches, and find items to help solve mysteries - and survive.

  • Challenging puzzles and deciphering

Solve locks, repair mechanisms, and study ancient symbols and texts to discover the path to the truth.

  • The path you choose

The order in which you examine the clues is up to you - each find reveals a new side of the story. But the ending is inevitable, and you can't change it.

  • Unique visual style

Gloomy, realistic graphics capture the spirit of the abandoned Middle Ages. Detailed locations - from mossy houses to a field of sunflowers at a pagan altar - immerse you in an atmosphere of hopelessness and ancient fear.

short_description: CallMara is a psychological thriller with elements of horror, set in a gloomy medieval village. The protagonist, waking up in the forest, discovers a devastated village and explores its secrets, gradually realizing that he has become the cause of the evil that has engulfed his village.
